post_production_workflow.step1: Generate 4 video segments with image_to_video (no text, no subtitles, visuals only)
post_production_workflow.step2: Generate voiceover audio with text_to_audio (Chinese male, rational clean tone, all 10 narration lines as one track)
post_production_workflow.step5: Add subtitles with ffmpeg drawtext (10 lines, timed per narration_lines)
post_production_workflow.step6: Add overlay text in segment 4 (brand name, tagline, GitHub URL) with ffmpeg drawtext
post_production_workflow.step7: Mix voiceover + BGM with ffmpeg amix (voiceover priority, BGM -12dB)
post_production_workflow.step8: Add SFX (UI clicks, whooshes) at timed positions with ffmpeg

voiceover_spec.tone: rational, clean, confident, moderate pace (~4 chars/sec)
voiceover_spec.emotion: neutral-professional, slight warmth at brand close
